PremiumEntitlement.title: PremiumEntitlement
PremiumEntitlement.description: Server-verified Google Play Premium subscription entitlement for a signed-in Soyken Play user. Strictly read-only for the owning user; written exclusively by Firebase Cloud Functions (Admin SDK) after verifying with Google Play Developer API Subscriptions V2.

active.description: Whether the user currently holds an active Soyken Premium entitlement.

subscriptionState.description: Google Play Subscriptions V2 state (e.g., SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_ACTIVE, SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_IN_GRACE_PERIOD, SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_CANCELED, SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_ON_HOLD, SUBSCRIPTION_STATE_EXPIRED, INACTIVE).

basePlanId.description: Active base plan ID (monthly or yearly).

expiryTimeMillis.description: Subscription expiry timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

autoRenewing.description: Whether the subscription is currently set to auto-renew.

orderId.description: Latest Google Play order ID associated with the subscription.

verifiedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last Google Play Developer API verification.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last document update.

PlayPurchaseTokenMapping.title: PlayPurchaseTokenMapping
PlayPurchaseTokenMapping.description: Server-only mapping from SHA-256 purchaseToken hash to Firebase UID used by RTDN Pub/Sub webhook to synchronize subscription lifecycle events. Completely inaccessible to clients.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/users/{userId}/entitlements/{entitlemen.description: User's server-verified Premium entitlement document (canonical document ID: 'premium'). Readable only by the authenticated owner; all client writes are denied.

/play_purchase_tokens/{tokenHash}.description: Server-only lookup index for Google Play RTDN purchase tokens. All client reads and writes are denied.
